gpu_tip: ~255GB total at 128K context — Unsloth's full-precision build, in seven files. It is a sparse MoE (8 of 256 experts routed per token), so most of those weights sit idle on any given token: a 16GB GPU (e.g. RTX 4080) holds the always-on attention and shared layers at full speed while llama.cpp offloads the inactive experts to a 256GB DDR5 workstation kit. Q8_0 gets within a hair of it at about half the memory.
mac_tip: Needs ~255GB — beyond every MacBook Pro and past a 256GB Mac Studio once macOS takes its share; only a 512GB M3 Ultra Mac Studio holds it.
